from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class CalendarConsolidatorExampleAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    
    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2024, 9, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        # Add the some trading pair.
        index = self.add_index("SPY")
        # Create a CalendarConsolidator that fires at 9:30 AM every day.
        calendar_consolidator = CalendarConsolidator(self._daily_open_etf_morning_trading_hours)
        # You can also create a CalendarConsolidator with a start time and duration.
        # calendar_consolidator = CalendarConsolidator(9, 30, timedelta(0))
        # Attach a consolidation handler that will receive the consolidated bars.
        calendar_consolidator.data_consolidated += self._consolidation_handler
        # Subscribe the consolidator for automatic updates with the prices of the asset.
        self.subscription_manager.add_consolidator(index, calendar_consolidator)
        
        self._index = index

    def _consolidation_handler(self, sender: object, consolidated_bar: BaseConsolidatedBar) -> None:
        # This example will buy the ETF if we are not already in a position
        # It will sell the ETF if we are already in a position
        # Therefore, it will trade daily to trade the same amount
        if not self._index.invested:
            self.set_holdings(self._index, 1)
        else:
            self.liquidate(self._index)

    def _daily_open_etf_morning_trading_hours(self, time: datetime) -> bool:
        # Open-trading-hours example: will return True 9:30-10:00 AM
        # while the market is open, so the method is only
        # active during the first 30 minutes of the trading day.
        if time.hour != 9 or time.minute < 30:
            return False
        # Stop trading 30 seconds after the open to avoid stale data.
        if self.utc_time % 300 < 30:
            return False
        return True
